os:config.name: rs-os-config
os:config.doc:name: ObjectStore Config
os:config.doc:description: Object Store configuration that keeps the circuit state of each source

os:object-store.name: rs-circuit-store
os:object-store.doc:description: Per source: consecutive failures and the moment the circuit opened; in memory, reset when the app restarts

sub-flow.name: resilience-call
sub-flow.doc:description: Calls flow vars.rsFlow with a per-source circuit breaker and one retry on connectivity; sets vars.rsResult

os:retrieve.doc:description: Reads the consecutive failures and the opening time of the source circuit

set-variable.doc:description: Consecutive failures that open the circuit: rs.source.failureThreshold, 3 by default
Milliseconds the circuit stays open: rs.source.openMillis, 30000 by default

choice.doc:description: If the circuit is open and its time has not expired, answers right away without calling the source

when.expression: #[output application/java --- vars.rsState.openedAt != null and ((now() as Number {unit: 'milliseconds'}) - vars.rsState.openedAt) < vars.rsOpenMillis]
when.doc:description: The circuit is still open: the source is not called

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { ok: false, source: vars.rsSource, reason: 'CIRCUIT_OPEN', message: 'Circuit open for ' ++ vars.rsSource }]
set-variable.doc:description: Marks the source as unavailable because the circuit is open

otherwise.doc:description: Calls the source; if the open time expired, this is the trial call

flow-ref.name: #[vars.rsFlow]
flow-ref.doc:description: Runs the read flow named in vars.rsFlow

flow-ref.name: rs-record-success
flow-ref.doc:description: Closes the circuit and sets the OK result

on-error-continue.when: #[output application/java --- (error.errorType.identifier == 'CONNECTIVITY') or ((error.description default '') startsWith 'Could not establish') or ((error.description default '') startsWith 'Could not obtain')]
on-error-continue.doc:description: On a connectivity failure, retries exactly once

try.doc:description: Second and last attempt after a connectivity failure

flow-ref.name: #[vars.rsFlow]
flow-ref.doc:description: Runs the read flow again, only once

flow-ref.name: rs-record-success
flow-ref.doc:description: Closes the circuit and sets the OK result

on-error-continue.doc:description: The retry failed too: records the failure without raising an error

flow-ref.name: rs-record-failure
flow-ref.doc:description: Counts the failure and opens the circuit when it reaches the threshold

on-error-continue.doc:description: Timeout or any other error: no retry, records the failure without raising an error

flow-ref.name: rs-record-failure
flow-ref.doc:description: Counts the failure and opens the circuit when it reaches the threshold

sub-flow.name: rs-record-success
sub-flow.doc:description: The source answered: resets the failures, closes the circuit and sets the OK result with the response

os:store.doc:description: Stores zero failures and a closed circuit for the source

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { ok: true, source: vars.rsSource, payload: payload }]
set-variable.doc:description: Marks the source as available and keeps its response

sub-flow.name: rs-record-failure
sub-flow.doc:description: The source failed: counts the failure, opens the circuit at the threshold and sets the unavailable result

set-variable.doc:description: Consecutive failures of the source, including this one

os:store.doc:description: Stores the failures; at the threshold also stores the time the circuit opened
os:store.os:value: #[output application/java --- { failures: vars.rsFailures, openedAt: if (vars.rsFailures >= vars.rsThreshold) (now() as Number {unit: 'milliseconds'}) else null }]

set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- { ok: false, source: vars.rsSource, reason: if ((error.errorType.identifier == 'CONNECTIVITY') or ((error.description default '') startsWith 'Could not establish') or ((error.description default '') startsWith 'Could not obtain')) 'CONNECTIVITY' else error.errorType.identifier, message: error.description }]
set-variable.doc:description: Marks the source as unavailable with the failure reason

sub-flow.name: resilience-partial-marker
sub-flow.doc:description: From the rsResult of each source builds vars.sources: OK or UNAVAILABLE per source and providers n of m

ee:transform.doc:description: provider-* sources are counted together as n of m; the rest are OK or UNAVAILABLE
